source_message.text: 85 pages of comic is the current estimate. here are the next two scripts. I think I gave you a version of the novel as well. it is broken up into three sections. that may be a better source than the scripts. take a look and let me know your thoughts.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
In that case, thank you very much. For that rate I will be able to spend some more time on the best way to present everything, rather than relying so closely on the screenplay.

Would you like me to get started on this next week, or should I wait for you to say "go?"

I can commit to scripting 80-85 comic pages. I'll look over the next two episodes and the novel, and work out how much of the story to cover in that space. As I do that, should I pace things with an eye toward eventually scripting the rest of the story? That is, should I aim for something that feels self-contained, or focus on leaving the reader asking, "What's next?"

Thanks,
Cory

ambiguity.description: The amount of story to cover and whether the volume should be self-contained or end as an open continuation remain unresolved.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes. I believe I was clear about that. Does this change your involvement?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I apologize for any confusion. I am hoping to get funding. The sample that I paid for was part of that. If the campaign is successful, I will be moving forward with the project. I am not asking you for any work yet. But if you would like to withdraw, please let me know ASAP.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: So, things did not go as well as I had hoped. Thanks for your participation and efforts. I will be closing the contract tomorrow. Of course I will leave you a top-notch review. I appreciate your time.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Cory,
The artist scheduled for this project has offered to create more artwork gratis and wants me to run the kickstarter again. So if you don't mind, I will keep the contract open. I will update you when anything changes.
Jeff

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Well, this project is on hold indefinitely. I am going to end the contract. I appreciate your time and will leave you excellent feedback. If you ever need anything let me know.
